verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say Git Large File Storage is available, but only when an admin enables it and the server's Git version is at least 2.1.2. This is a single conditional mention with no detail on storage backends, limits, or hands-on use. Missing for 10: in-depth LFS documentation (configuration, storage backends, size limits, locking), confirmation that it is enabled by default, and independent or community corroboration of LFS working in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store large binary files with Git LFS

citations.quote: Git Large File Storage will be available if enabled and if your Git version is >= 2.1.2
